entry.en: Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay and have 2 blank pages for entry stamps.
entry.es: Su pasaporte debe ser válido durante toda su estancia y tener 2 páginas en blanco para los sellos de entrada.
entry.quote: Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay and have 2 blank pages for entry stamps.

entry.en: You must have a certificate proving a yellow fever vaccination to pass border control, due to a risk of yellow fever transmission.
entry.es: Debe tener un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla para pasar el control fronterizo, por el riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: To pass border control in Burkina Faso, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination, due to a risk of yellow fever transmission.

entry.en: There are strict customs regulations about taking cultural objects like masks, religious materials and antiquities out of Burkina Faso.
entry.es: Hay normas aduaneras estrictas para sacar de Burkina Faso objetos culturales como máscaras, materiales religiosos y antigüedades.
entry.quote: There are strict customs regulations about taking cultural objects like masks, religious materials and antiquities out of Burkina Faso.

safety.en: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Burkina Faso.
safety.es: Es muy probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Burkina Faso.
safety.quote: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Burkina Faso.

safety.en: There is a very high threat of kidnapping by Al-Qaeda and regional Islamic State-affiliated groups in Burkina Faso.
safety.es: Existe una amenaza muy alta de secuestro por parte de Al Qaeda y grupos regionales afiliados al Estado Islámico en Burkina Faso.
safety.quote: There’s a very high threat of kidnapping by Al-Qaeda and regional Islamic State-affiliated groups in Burkina Faso.

safety.en: The political situation remains unstable following the military coup on 30 September 2022, and further coups are possible.
safety.es: La situación política sigue inestable tras el golpe militar del 30 de septiembre de 2022, y son posibles nuevos golpes.
safety.quote: The political situation also remains unstable following the military coup on 30 September 2022. Further coups are possible.

safety.en: Avoid travelling at night, even with a local driver, as roads have very limited lighting and vehicles often have no headlights.
safety.es: Evite viajar de noche, incluso con un conductor local, pues las carreteras tienen muy poca iluminación y los vehículos a menudo no tienen faros.
safety.quote: Avoid travelling at night, even if using a local driver. Roads have very limited lighting, and vehicles often have no headlights.

safety.en: Thieves, often armed, are particularly active near the UN Circle and former Central Market in Ouagadougou; do not walk alone at night.
safety.es: Los ladrones, a menudo armados, son especialmente activos cerca del UN Circle y el antiguo Mercado Central de Uagadugú; no camine solo de noche.
safety.quote: Thieves are particularly active near the UN Circle and the former Central Market in Ouagadougou, and are often armed. Do not carry valuables in public places or walk alone at night.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual activity and the promotion of same-sex relationships is a criminal offence, with prison sentences of up to 5 years.
safety.es: La actividad sexual entre personas del mismo sexo y la promoción de relaciones homosexuales es delito, con penas de hasta 5 años de prisión.
safety.quote: Same sex sexual activity and the ‘promotion’ of same-sex relationships is a criminal offence in Burkina Faso. If convicted, such charges could lead to prison sentences of up to 5 years.

health.en: Medical facilities are very limited, and evacuation to Europe is necessary for serious medical treatment.
health.es: Los centros médicos son muy limitados y para tratamientos graves es necesaria la evacuación a Europa.
health.quote: Medical facilities in Burkina Faso are very limited. For serious medical treatment, evacuation to Europe is necessary.

health.en: Yellow fever vaccination is required in order to enter the country.
health.es: Se exige la vacuna contra la fiebre amarilla para entrar al país.
health.quote: Yellow fever vaccination is required in order to enter the country.

health.en: Malaria is a serious problem, so start taking prophylaxis before leaving and continue while there.
health.es: La malaria es un problema grave, así que empiece la profilaxis antes de viajar y continúe mientras esté allí.
health.quote: Malaria is a serious problem, so be sure to begin taking prophylaxis prior to leaving for Burkina and continue taking it while there

health.en: The water is not safe to drink, especially outside the big cities where untreated well water is often the norm.
health.es: El agua no es segura para beber, sobre todo fuera de las grandes ciudades, donde suele usarse agua de pozo sin tratar.
health.quote: The water is not safe to drink, especially outside the big cities where untreated well water is often the norm.

health.en: Meningitis is also a problem, and vaccination is highly recommended.
health.es: La meningitis también es un problema y se recomienda mucho la vacunación.
health.quote: Meningitis is also a problem, and vaccination is also highly recommended.

health.en: Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover medical treatment abroad and medical evacuation.
health.es: Asegúrese de tener un seguro médico de viaje adecuado y fondos accesibles para cubrir el tratamiento médico en el extranjero y la evacuación.
health.quote: Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment abroad and medical evacuation.

help.en: In Ouagadougou the emergency numbers are 18 for ambulance and fire, and 17 for police.
help.es: En Uagadugú los números de emergencia son el 18 para ambulancia y bomberos, y el 17 para la policía.

help.en: Outside Ouagadougou, the emergency services are unlikely to respond.
help.es: Fuera de Uagadugú, es poco probable que los servicios de emergencia respondan.
help.quote: Outside Ouagadougou, the emergency services are unlikely to respond.

help.en: Call 18 from Ouagadougou for an ambulance; outside Ouagadougou, call the universal emergency number 112.
help.es: Llame al 18 desde Uagadugú para pedir una ambulancia; fuera de Uagadugú, llame al número universal de emergencias 112.
help.quote:
Call 18 from Ouagadougou and ask for an ambulance.

Outside Ouagadougou, call the universal emergency number 112.

getting_in.en: Flights are available through Abidjan, Brussels, Casablanca, Dakar, Niamey and Paris on carriers including Air Burkina and Brussels Airlines.
getting_in.es: Hay vuelos a través de Abiyán, Bruselas, Casablanca, Dakar, Niamey y París con aerolíneas como Air Burkina y Brussels Airlines.
getting_in.quote: Flights are available through Abidjan, Brussels, Casablanca, Dakar, Niamey, Paris on the following carriers: Air Algérie, Air Burkina, Brussels Airlines, Royal Air Maroc.

getting_in.en: At Ouagadougou Airport, uniformed men will want to carry your luggage and expect about CFA500 (US$1) per bag, at least from a foreigner.
getting_in.es: En el aeropuerto de Uagadugú, hombres uniformados querrán sacar su equipaje y esperarán unos CFA500 (1 USD) por maleta, al menos de un extranjero.
getting_in.quote: Upon arriving at the carousel at Ouagadougou Airport to claim your luggage, a number of men in uniforms will want to take your luggage out for you. They will expect to receive about CFA500 (US$1) per bag (at least from a foreigner).

getting_in.en: There is a 517-km railway stretch from Ouagadougou to the Cote d'Ivoire border.
getting_in.es: Hay un tramo ferroviario de 517 km desde Uagadugú hasta la frontera con Costa de Marfil.
getting_in.quote: There is a 517-km railway stretch from Ouagadougou to the Cote d'Ivoire border.

getting_in.en: Count on about a 48-hour train trip from Abidjan to Ouagadougou, and slightly less than 24 hours from Bouake to Banfora.
getting_in.es: Cuente con unas 48 horas en tren de Abiyán a Uagadugú, y algo menos de 24 horas de Bouaké a Banfora.
getting_in.quote: Count on about a 48-hr train trip from Abidjan to Ouagadougou, and slightly less than 24 hr for the trip from Bouake to Banfora.

getting_in.en: You can take the bus in and out of Burkina Faso to and from the neighboring countries of Ghana, Mali and Benin.
getting_in.es: Se puede entrar y salir de Burkina Faso en autobús desde y hacia los países vecinos Ghana, Malí y Benín.
getting_in.quote: You can also take the bus in and out of Burkina Faso to and from the neighboring countries of Ghana, Mali, and Benin.

getting_around.en: There are buses and vans to Benin, Côte d'Ivoire, Ghana, Mali, Niger and Togo.
getting_around.es: Hay autobuses y furgonetas a Benín, Costa de Marfil, Ghana, Malí, Níger y Togo.
getting_around.quote: There are buses and vans (cars) to Benin, Côte d'Ivoire, Ghana, Mali, Niger, and Togo.

getting_around.en: There is a train service on the Abidjan-Banfora-Bobo-Ouaga route, and hitchhiking is not common.
getting_around.es: Hay servicio de tren en la ruta Abiyán-Banfora-Bobo-Uagadugú, y el autostop no es común.
getting_around.quote: There is a train service for the Abidjan-Banfora-Bobo-Ouaga route. Hitchhiking is not common.

getting_around.en: You can rent a bike (about CFA3000) or a moto (about CFA6,000) to get around locally.
getting_around.es: Puede alquilar una bicicleta (unos CFA3000) o una moto (unos CFA6000) para moverse localmente.
getting_around.quote: Rent a bike (~ CFA3000) or a moto (~ CFA6,000) to get around locally.

getting_around.en: Even wealthy Burkinabé use buses between major cities; the major routes from Ouagadougou are in good condition, though taxi drivers can be erratic.
getting_around.es: Incluso los burkineses ricos usan autobuses entre ciudades importantes; las rutas principales desde Uagadugú están en buen estado, pero los taxistas pueden ser erráticos.
getting_around.quote: Even wealthy Burkinabé who own cars do not use them to travel between major cities, but opt for buses instead. The major routes between Ouagadougou and other cities are in good condition; taxi drivers can be erratic.

getting_around.en: Roads, even paved ones, are in poor repair, and conditions off the main roads are often difficult, especially in the rainy season from June to October.
getting_around.es: Las carreteras, incluso las asfaltadas, están en mal estado y fuera de las principales suelen ser difíciles, sobre todo en la temporada de lluvias de junio a octubre.
getting_around.quote: Roads, even if they are paved, are in a poor state of repair. Road conditions off the main roads are often difficult, especially in the rainy season from June to October.

money.en: The currency is the West African CFA franc (CFA, ISO code XOF).
money.es: La moneda es el franco CFA de África Occidental (CFA, código ISO XOF).
money.quote: The currency of the country is the West African CFA franc, denoted CFA (ISO currency code: XOF).

money.en: The CFA franc is fixed at 1 euro = 655.957 CFA francs.
money.es: El franco CFA está fijado en 1 euro = 655,957 francos CFA.
money.quote: Both currencies are fixed at a rate of 1 euro = 655.957 CFA francs.

money.en: Only a few larger hotels and restaurants in Ouagadougou accept credit cards, and you are unlikely to be able to use them outside the capital.
money.es: Solo unos pocos hoteles y restaurantes grandes de Uagadugú aceptan tarjetas de crédito, y es poco probable que pueda usarlas fuera de la capital.
money.quote: A few of the larger hotels and restaurants in Ouagadougou accept credit cards. You’re unlikely to be able to use them anywhere outside the capital.

money.en: There are a few ATMs in Ouagadougou, but they only accept Visa cards.
money.es: Hay algunos cajeros en Uagadugú, pero solo aceptan tarjetas Visa.
money.quote: There are a few ATMs in Ouagadougou, but they only accept Visa cards.

money.en: The best option is to bring US dollars in cash to exchange.
money.es: La mejor opción es llevar dólares estadounidenses en efectivo para cambiar.
money.quote: The best option is to bring US dollars in cash to exchange.

etiquette.en: Always greet and acknowledge people wherever you go; not doing so is considered extremely rude.
etiquette.es: Salude y reconozca siempre a las personas dondequiera que vaya; no hacerlo se considera extremadamente grosero.
etiquette.quote: Always make it a point to greet and acknowledge people wherever you go; not doing so is considered extremely rude.

etiquette.en: Never use your left hand to shake hands or give something to someone, as the left hand is commonly associated with bathroom purposes.
etiquette.es: Nunca use la mano izquierda para saludar o dar algo a alguien, pues se asocia comúnmente con el uso del baño.
etiquette.quote: Never use your left hand to shake hands with someone or give something to someone; the left hand is commonly associated with bathroom purposes.

etiquette.en: During Ramadan, do not eat, drink, smoke or chew gum in public in the daytime, including in your car.
etiquette.es: Durante el Ramadán, no coma, beba, fume ni mastique chicle en público durante el día, ni siquiera en su coche.
etiquette.quote:
Ramadan is a holy month for Muslims. The dates vary by year and country. During this time, do not:

- eat, drink, smoke or chew gum in public in the daytime, including in your car

etiquette.en: Do not take pictures of military or other government installations.
etiquette.es: No tome fotos de instalaciones militares ni otras instalaciones gubernamentales.
etiquette.quote: Do not take pictures of military or other government installations.

etiquette.en: Politics can be an extremely touchy subject to discuss in Burkina Faso.
etiquette.es: La política puede ser un tema extremadamente delicado en Burkina Faso.
etiquette.quote: Politics can be an extremely touchy subject to discuss in Burkina Faso.

etiquette.en: You are unlikely to cause offense by discussing religion, but always approach the subject with respect.
etiquette.es: Es poco probable que ofenda al hablar de religión, pero aborde siempre el tema con respeto.
etiquette.quote: unlikely to cause offense by discussing religion, but always approach the subject with respect.
